typeBlock.description: This type is used to carry raw baseband binary data in the GDDI payload with corresponding metadata used by recipients to process the data. These messages are typically transferred between Modem and FEP applications or between FEP and Crypto-Bookend applications, and are used when only a raw baseband bitstream is needed with minimal processed metadata. An example of this raw data is a downlink baseband telemetry bitstream from a Modem's demodulator.

tlv.description: Length in bits of the raw data payload. This value must be greater than zero to provide a meaningful data payload length. (Default: 0)
Sequence Number used to detect out-of-order or lost data. (Default: 0)
Timestamp for this raw data, representing the number of non-leap seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970. (Default: 0)
The number of picoseconds representing the fractional portion of the 'Timestamp Seconds' metadata. (Default: 0)
